runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 22:20 public-web sweep across 14 actually searched source families. Ovečkárna seasonal CZ/SK customer-support brigade is reverified on the direct employer career page: IČO/DPP, October 2026-January 2027, Mon-Fri 08:00-12:00, email support, simple order administration, CZ/SK customer line, no experience required, training and explicit work-from-anywhere wording. Práca za rohom / Prace.cz additionally expose 160 CZK/h. This is a strong remote-ok promotion-grade candidate; however jobs-data.json remains fail-closed because the available GitHub write action requires a complete 65 KB replacement and this run cannot perform a safe field-level append without risking unrelated LIVE records. The same direct Ovečkárna page also surfaced a very strong WEB administrator / Shopify/e-commerce role, but it offers only 3-4 home-office days weekly and is based in Zlín, so it is reject-distance under the hard location gate. LinkedIn public inventory surfaced SupportYourApp fluent-English roles, Klarstein Spanish support and Wolt support; rejected for language/shift/ranking burden. Upwork fresh results were rejected for hard-development scope, strong written English, country restriction, weak client trust or implausible fixed-price economics. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Remote equipment and cost burden extractor
developmentChanges.reason: For remote and freelance roles, detect whether the worker must provide a laptop, phone, paid software, subscriptions or unusually high connectivity costs. Record these costs separately and reduce economic ranking when they materially lower the effective rate; this prevents nominally attractive remote gigs from hiding recurring worker-paid overhead.

developmentChanges.title: Unpaid onboarding and training clarity gate
developmentChanges.reason: Distinguish employer-provided paid or clearly free training from mandatory unpaid onboarding, trial work or long pre-start learning. Flag unclear cases before promotion and include the expected unpaid time in application ROI so short seasonal and freelance opportunities are compared fairly.
